description: Validation rules specific to NHANES SAS XPT files

rules.name: xpt_file_structure_valid
rules.description: File must be valid SAS XPT transport format

rules.name: seqn_primary_key_present
rules.description: SEQN (sequence number) must be present for record linkage
rules.condition: SEQN column is NULL for all rows
rules.rationale: SEQN is primary key for NHANES cross-table joins

rules.name: survey_weights_optional
rules.description: Survey weights (WTMEC2YR, WTINT2YR) may be missing
rules.rationale: Weights needed for national estimates, not for pipeline performance metrics

rules.name: sentinel_value_normalization
rules.description: CDC sentinel values must be converted to NULL
rules.rationale: NHANES uses numeric codes for missing/refused responses

rules.name: temporal_precision_aggregated
rules.description: NHANES survey months aggregated to 2-year cycles
rules.rationale: NHANES provides cycle-level temporal data, not exact dates
rules.action_on_failure: Set low_precision_time=1; use cycle start date for period_id

rules.name: lab_result_loinc_codes
rules.description: Lab results should have LOINC codes for standardization
rules.condition: Lab result variable has no LOINC mapping
rules.action_on_failure: Warn; use NHANES variable name as fallback

rules.name: demographic_data_complete
rules.description: Core demographics (RIDAGEYR, RIAGENDR) must be present
rules.condition: Age or gender missing for >5% of rows
rules.rationale: Demographic variables needed for stratified analysis

rules.name: examination_data_sparsity_tolerance
rules.condition: Examination variable missing for 10-25% of participants
rules.rationale: Participant refusal or contraindications are expected
rules.action_on_failure: Warn; drop rows with missing exam data

rules.name: cycle_version_consistency
rules.description: File must belong to consistent survey cycle
rules.rationale: Mismatched cycle indicators suggest data corruption

rules.name: column_name_uppercase
rules.description: NHANES variables are uppercase by convention

low_precision_time.impact: Excluded from month-stratified analyses; contribute to overall counts

nhanes_specific_assumptions.virginia_weighting: State-level weights available via RECODE variables

validation_pass_criteria.v1_strict: All required variables present; no sentinel values allowed
validation_pass_criteria.v2_relaxed: Core schema intact + SEQN present + <5% demographic missingness
